QF.id: SIA Case Studies on SAS Standards_38

question.text: Under SAS-500, CO2e avoided must be reported using an accepted methodology. The MOST accepted international protocol is:

answer.text: GHG Protocol (WBCSD/WRI) Corporate Standard, with Scope 1/2/3 boundary definition and explicit emission factors cited

explanation.text: The Logic: GHG Protocol is the globally accepted standard for corporate greenhouse-gas accounting — Scope 1 (direct), Scope 2 (energy indirect), Scope 3 (other indirect). SAS-500 references this for CO2e attribution. The Trap: Options B, C, D are not standardised methodologies. Cross-Exam Context: Same GHG Protocol cited in SEBI BRSR (III-A / III-C Compliance) and XV (Research Analyst — ESG factor models). Assessor's Pro-Tip: Always cite the emission factor source (CEA grid emission factor, IPCC AR6, etc.) with the factor value and the publication year. Emission factors change annually and a stale factor biases the number.
